movie.title: Casino Royale
movie.overview: Le Chiffre, a banker to the world's terrorists, is scheduled to participate in a high-stakes poker game in Montenegro, where he intends to use his winnings to establish his financial grip on the terrorist market. M sends Bond—on his maiden mission as a 00 Agent—to attend this game and prevent Le Chiffre from winning. With the help of Vesper Lynd and Felix Leiter, Bond enters the most important poker game in his already dangerous career.

facts: Did you know the villain Le Chiffre wasn't just any bad guy? He was specifically a banker for terrorists, planning to use his poker winnings to establish a financial grip on the terrorist market!
Believe it or not, this high-stakes mission to stop Le Chiffre was actually Bond's very first assignment as a 00 Agent! Talk about jumping straight into the deep end.
This wasn't just any poker game for Bond; the text explicitly states it was the most important one in his entire (already dangerous!) career. The stakes were truly personal for 007.
